ideas.title: FBI's refusal to share evidence in Alex Pretti case sparks controversy
ideas.description: Investigate the implications of the FBI's refusal to share evidence with Minnesota investigators in the Alex Pretti shooting case.
ideas.angle: Explore the potential consequences of the FBI's actions on the investigation and public trust.
questions: What are the implications of the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
How will this affect the investigation?
ideas.insight: The FBI's actions may indicate a larger issue with transparency and cooperation between federal and state agencies.
